column1: # HMMER benchmark cases.
# Format: <name> <tier> <group>[:flags] <command>
#   tier   S (smoke, ~5 min) < M (~30 min) < L (hours); a tier includes all smaller tiers
#   group  reporting bucket (per-group geometric-mean speed ratio is reported)
#   flags  nohash : don't hash outputs (timing-only, e.g. build, kernel drivers)
#          kernel : time = the driver's own "# CPU time ... Elapsed:" (kernel loop only), Mc/s recorded
#   command runs under bash in a fresh dir; "setup ;; timed" runs setup untimed first.
#   D/ = derived datasets, fx/ = fixtures, $ROOT $BUILD $IMPL $NCPU are set.
# Every hashed case's normalized outputs (stdout, stderr, all files) must match
# dev/bench/golden.json; repeated reps must produce identical outputs.
build_configure          S build:nohash      $ROOT/configure -q > /dev/null
build_make_par           S build:nohash      $ROOT/configure -q >/dev/null ;; make -j$NCPU > /dev/null 2>&1
build_make_dev           M build:nohash      $ROOT/configure -q >/dev/null ;; make -j$NCPU dev > /dev/null 2>&1
